notes.title: [Official Update 1.01] Aprtil 27th 2018
notes.notes:
General

Various bug fixes on general gameplay, Power Up items and more.
Fixed a bug where Height Adjuster moved SteamVR Camera Rig position too far or too close to Gameplay area.


Lich

Laser Turret's Laser Beam now pierces Gravity Bomb.
Prevented environment objects from going too far away from the Gameplay Area.


The Lich
Main Phylactery moved closer to The Lich on Gameplay Area.
Reality Rip

 Reality Rip now destroy Power Up items instead of equipping them for The Lich.

Gravity Bomb

Gravity Bomb now destroy Power Up items instead of equipping them for The Lich.
Gravity Bomb's gravity pull effect range from 30 to 32 and force increased from 0.15 to 0.17.
Gravity Bomb ignroes Slow Time and Time Vault time scaling effects.

Ice Shard

Ice Shard projectile hit on Power Up items now equips the Power Up item for The Lich.
Ice Shard projectile destroys Laser turrets
Ice Shard's Ice Spike no longer destroys Laser Turrets but Ice Spike's end explosion destroys Laser turrets.
Ice Shard's Ice Spike end explosion is the only way to destroy Shielded Laser turret.

Shielded Laser Turret is a Laser Turret where XR24 has used Pillar of Hope nearby.




XR24

XR24 has damage immunity while respawning.
XR24 Attack Wind Up time while airborne decreased from 0,22 to 0,1.
Time Vault time scaling now occurs twice as fast as before.

notes.title: [Official Update] Mar 29th 2018
notes.notes:
Lich Custom Variables, Power-up Items for Bosses, Some Background Music, Tweaks & Fixes

General
All Bosses can use Power-Up Items.
Bug fixes
Graphical updates.
Menu
Added background music
Luna
Added Power-Up Item spawn points.
Lich
Lich now has Custom Variables.
Damage Hero takes when running out of Stamina scales up.
Hero's Air Attack has a wind-up time.
Hero running out of Stamina during Time Vault no longer cancels the ability.
Hero can break Ice Spikes to regain Stamina.
Hero is affected by Gravity Bomb's pull force while gliding.
Increased wind-up time for Hero's Pillar of Hope.
Stamina Hero regenerates during Dive is reduced.
Decreased Hero's Dive speed.
Hero's Dive ignores slow time effects.
Increased Ice Spike's lifetime.
Decreased Boss' Gravity Bomb's speed.
Varied damage done by different spells.
Boss' Reality Rip ignores slow time effects.
Added background music.

notes.title: [Official Update] Mar 16th 2018
notes.notes:
Lair Custom Variables, New Power Up Items, New Ability, Tweaks & Fixes


Luna

Included all Power Up Items in Luna.
Changes to Custom Variables in Luna: 

Hero Damage Multipliers also now affects Normal Attacks, Combo Attack, Electro Mine, Dash and Dive.

Added an effect for splashing water.


Lair

Included all Power Up Items in Lair.
Included Custom Variables to Lair:

Hero Damage Multipliers now affects Normal Attacks, Ranged Attack, Counter, Dash and Dive.
Hero Move Speed affects Hero’s maximum movement speed.
Hero Health affects Hero’s maximum health points.
Hero Jump affects Hero’s maximum count of jumps.
Boss Health affects Boss’ maximum health points.
Boss Damage Multipliers now affects Normal Attacks, Headbutt, Ambush and Fire Breath.

Lair Hero Ranged Attack projectile's scale now grows while travelling.


Lich

Included all Power Up Items in Lich.
Added one extra Laser Turret and Phylactery.
Laser Turret model updated. 
Laser Turret targets Boss’ body. It damages and pierces the Main Phylactery if it is on the Laser Beams line of fire.
Lich Hero
 
When running out of Stamina, they take a small amount of damage and gain full Stamina, instead of taking constant small damage.
Now has a small Stamina regeneration while in Free Movement.
Dash change: Without direction input, Hero always Dashes to left from Hero’s direction.
Pillar of Hope:

Has now two different uses:

Hero is grounded: Activates Pillar of Hope around the Hero, stopping Hero’s and the current Ring Circle’s movement and rotation from Gameplay Area’s rotation. Generates three Shielded Ring Pieces on the Ring Circle. Shielded Ring Pieces can be broken only by Ice Shards or Boss’ Normal Attacks. 
Hero is airborne: Activates Pillar of Hope below the Hero, stopping Hero’s movement and rotation from Gameplay Area’s rotation and generating a platform for the Hero to land on. Does not affect the rotation of the current Ring Circle, but generates Shielded Ring Pieces from Ring Pieces travelling through the Pillar of Hope. Shielded Ring Pieces can be broken only by Ice Shards or Boss’ Normal Attacks. 

Pillar of Hope now has a wind up time 0.08 s and and an end lag time 0.33 s

Glide :

Button bind changed from B/Circle to Right Trigger / R2.
Glide can be canceled with Dive by pressing Glide button again.

Has new ability: Time Vault

Slows every Character’s and Projectiles’ action and movement speed while using and consumes Stamina.
Button bind B/Circle.
Can be holded for longer use.
Simultaneous uses from many Heroes do not stack.




Power Up Items

Power Up Items are currently usable for Heroes.
Power Up Items can be destroyed by Boss by touching / hitting them.
Changes to Power Up Items:

Damage (NEW)

Provides the Character who uses the Power Up Item an increase to damage for a short duration.

Slow Time (NEW)

Slows every other Character’s action and movement speed except the Character who uses the Power Up Item.

Shield (NEW)

Provides a Shield to the Character who uses the Power Up Item which neglects damage for a short duration.

Speed 

Increased maximum speed increase.

Health

No changes.

Invisibility

No changes.




Custom Variables

Fixes and adjustments in Luna.
Applied to Lair.


Menu

Pause Menu button models have been updated.
Main Menu Quality Settings will now highlight current selected quality.
Added Lair Custom Variables menu to Main Menu.
Fixed various issues on object activations.

notes.title: [Official Update] Third Level: Lich, Custom Variables and Power Up Items
notes.notes:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Introducing new features:

    Third level Lich
    Custom Variables
    Power Up items


General Changes

    SteamVR Controller changes
    Settings


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Lich

First playable version of the third level called Lich. Playable with 1-4 heroes.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31665847/56f97314b26a71297032214249298a7dbaec1dc9.png

Boss

    Boss uses spells found around them. First playable version has three spells: Gravity Bomb, Reality Rip and Ice Shard. The spells are activated on Boss hands by touching Spell Orbs around Boss' standing area and used by pressing Virtual Reality controller triggers and physical movement of controllers.
    Boss can grab the Outer Ring and spin the Gameplay Area by using the Virtual Reality controllers Grip buttons.


Hero

    Hero has two movements states; Locked and Free Movement.
    Hero's Locked Movement activates by landing on Gameplay Area's Inner Rings which are not broken.
    Hero's Free Movement activates after jumping and activating Gliding. Hero can Glide freely above or under the Gameplay Area. 
    Hero has Jump, Dash and Dive.
    Hero has a Stamina Bar, and their actions cost Stamina. Stamina regenerates while Locked Movement is activated (=Grounded). Losing all Stamina causes Hero to take damage.
    Hero can summon a Pillar of Hope: high stamina cost ability that let's hero stand on it. Pillar of Hope protects Hero from Gameplay Area's movement.
    Hero can collect Power Up Items by touching them and activate them with Controller triggers.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31665847/9cb5a40fc88cb21733b5353faa72ee17dab49ff4.png

Gameplay

    Gameplay area of Lich is breakable by Boss' Spells.
    Boss is able to rotate the Gameplay Area.
    Gameplay differs from the first two levels: Hero's target of damage are map objectives. Boss deals damage by hitting the Hero with their spells.


Map Objectvies
There are two different kind of Map Objectives on Lich: 

    Laser Turret: Activated by Hero's attack: After a time, shoots a Laser Beam towards Boss and deals damage. Boss can block the Laser Beam and reduce damage with their Hands. Laser Turrets spawn on the Gameplay Area. Multiple Laser Turrets can be activated simultaneously.
    Phylactery: Boss' Soul is sealed inside Phylacteries and can be damaged by Hero's melee attacks. One main Phylactery is located in front of the Boss which can be damaged multiple times. Other Phylacteries spawn on the Gameplay Area and can be damaged once.




Custom Variables

First introduction of Custom Variables, currently in use for the first level Luna


    Custom Variables can be edited in Virtual Reality.
    Custom Variables can be accessed from Main Menu. Each level have their own Custom Variables selections (Disabled now for Lair and Lich). 
    Player has three Custom Presets to save their preferred values:Custom 1, 2 and 3. Remember to use Save while adjusting variables.
    Default selects the default variables.
    Main Menu Skybox will react to the custom variables selected.
    Variables can be changed after selecting one of the Heroes or the Boss of the selected Level.
    Current Custom Variables are: Damage, Health, Jumps and  Movement Speed of each Hero and Damage and Health of the Boss.
    Custom Variables other than Jumps are Multipliers applied to default balance variables. E.g. Move Speed 2x means double the Move Speed compared to the Default value. Jumps are considered as number of units. E.g. 4 Jumps means a Hero can jump four times.
    Current Minimum Multiplier value is 0.1 and Maximum Multiplier value is 10.



Power Up Items

First introduction of Power Up Items, currently in use for the third level Lich includes Health, Invisibility and Speed.

    Health: Heals the Hero who uses the Power Up Item for a small amount.
    Invisibility: Provides the Hero who uses the Power Up Item invisbility. While active, the Boss is unable to see the Hero.
    Speed: Provides the Hero who uses the Power Up Item an increase to movement speed for a short duration.
    Hero can collect Power Up Items by touching them.
    Hero can activate Power Up Items by Controller triggers.


SteamVR Controller changes

Changes to Controller buttons as SteamVR counts them as OpenVR System Button presses and toggles SteamVR Menu for Virtual Reality player.

    Xbox One: removed keybinds from Change View and Menu buttons.
    Xbox 360: removed keybinds from Back and Start buttons.
    PS4: removed keybinds from Share and Options buttons.
    Custom Controllers: removed keybinds from Back and Start buttons.


Settings

First introduction of Settings.


    Settings can be found and used on the right side of the VR player while in Main Menu. Setting objects are Selected and Activated by Pointing and Clicking/Holding with Virtual Reality controller triggers.
    Edit only in Virtual Reality.
    Music volume
    Sound Effects volume
    Ambience volume
    Video Quality Settings (Low/Med/High)
